```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for Age
df['Age'] = 2023 - df['Year_Birth']

# Set the theme
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a boxplot for Income distribution by Marital_Status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Marital_Status', y='Income', palette='Set2')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Income Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Income', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
